content.raw:
WWE Raw del 25 maggio 2026 - risultati e momenti salienti

Direttamente dallo Schottenstein Center di Columbus, Ohio, andiamo in onda con una puntata di Raw ricca di tensione e prospettive in vista di Clash in Italy.

Paul Heyman e il confronto con Oba Femi

Paul Heyman apre lo show parlando del dream match tra Oba Femi e Brock Lesnar per Clash in Italy. Viene trasmesso un video di Lesnar che, con sarcasmo, promette di umiliare Femi. L'attuale campione non si lascia intimidire: entra sul ring, stuzzica Heyman e firma ufficialmente il contratto per il match, dichiarando che, se la scorsa volta combatteva per vincere, questa volta combatterà per "uccidere".

Penta vs. Je'Von Evans (Intercontinental Championship)

Match molto dinamico che vede contrapposti due alleati recenti. Nonostante le ottime manovre di Evans, tra cui il suo iconico OG Cutter, Penta riesce a prevalere grazie a un devastante Mexican Destroyer. Al termine del match, Evans rifiuta la stretta di mano di Penta e abbandona il ring.

Segmenti nel backstage e il dramma del Vision

Michael Cole annuncia l'infortunio (strappo al tricipite) di Logan Paul. Nel backstage, Paul Heyman comunica ad Austin Theory che Bron Breakker prenderà il posto di Paul come suo partner per i titoli di coppia. Joe Hendry prova a cantare una canzone di “scuse” per Paul, ma viene brutalmente attaccato da Theory. Successivamente, Seth Rollins e Montez Ford decidono di collaborare per porre fine all'egemonia del Vision, concordando di scontrarsi tra loro.

Judgment Day (Roxanne Perez & Raquel Rodriguez) vs. Bayley & Lyra Valkyria

Il match si infiamma con l'interferenza costante di Liv Morgan e Dominik Mysterio. La situazione degenera quando Dominik prova a usare il titolo AAA Mega come arma: il piano fallisce e Perez colpisce accidentalmente Dominik. Bayley ne approfitta per chiudere con un roll-up. Vincitrici: Bayley e Lyra Valkyria.

LA Knight vs. The Bloodline

LA Knight torna a farsi sentire, criticando la nuova attitudine di Jimmy e Jey Uso al seguito di Roman Reigns. Jimmy si presenta per un confronto verbale molto acceso, avvertendo Knight di non parlare più della famiglia Anoa'i. Knight risponde che non ha problemi con gli Usos, ma il suo obiettivo resta Reigns.

Seth Rollins vs. Montez Ford

Grande intensità tra i due atleti. Rollins riesce a spuntarla con un Curb Stomp dopo aver evitato una 450 Splash. Nel post-match, Austin Theory attacca selvaggiamente Angelo Dawkins, spingendo Rollins a chiedere a Pearce un match contro Bron Breakker.

Rey Mysterio vs. Rusev (Number One Contender Match)

In un match valevole per lo status di primo sfidante, Rey Mysterio e Rusev danno vita a una battaglia tecnica. Rey riesce a trionfare con un roll-up dopo aver evitato la Accolade. Al termine, Rusev attacca Rey, ma interviene Dragon Lee a salvare il General Manager.

Firma del contratto: Roman Reigns e Jacob Fatu

Il main event vede la firma ufficiale per il Tribal Combat Match a Clash in Italy. Fatu accusa Reigns di aver usato mezzi scorretti a Backlash. Reigns risponde fermamente: se Fatu vincerà in Italia, diventerà il nuovo leader della famiglia; in caso contrario, dovrà servire e imparare dal Tribal Chief. Lo show si chiude con uno sguardo di sfida tra i due.

source_excerpt:
Welcome to Wrestling Inc.'s results for "WWE Raw" on May 25, 2026, coming to you live from the Schottenstein Center in Columbus, Ohio!

Coming off his successful defense against Ethan Page at WWE Saturday Night's Main Event this past Saturday, Penta will be putting the Intercontinental Championship on the line once again tonight as he defends against Je'Von Evans. Penta and Evans have proved to be allies over the last few weeks, emerging victorious against Page and Rusev in tag team competition on the May 4 episode of "Raw".

Oba Femi looked to issue another Oba Femi Open Challenge during last Monday's episode of "Raw", but that never ultimately came to fruition when Brock Lesnar returned and blindsided Femi with four F5s out of frustration for losing to him at Night Two of WWE WrestleMania 42. Following such, Femi will be making an appearance in the opening moments of tonight's show with something on his mind to share.

Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez of Judgment Day will be joining forces with one another to take on Bayley and Lyra Valkyria. After Perez and Rodriguez were unsuccessful in challenging Paige and Brie Bella for their Women's Tag Team Championship last Monday, the two women and their stablemate Women's World Champion Liv Morgan blindsided Paige and Brie with an attack which prompted Bayley and Lyra Valkyria to come to their aid.

Additionally, titleholder Roman Reigns and Jacob Fatu are set to make their World Heavyweight Championship Tribal Combat Match at WWE Clash in Italy this coming Sunday official when they put pen-to-paper with a contract signing.

We are live! Michael Cole and Corey Graves greet audiences at home as Paul Heyman is waiting in the ring.

We Hear From Paul Heyman

Heyman introduces himself and welcomes fans to "Raw", then says he's in the ring to hype up a dream match in all of professional wrestling and not just in WWE when Oba Femi faces Brock Lesnar at Clash in Italy.

We then head over to a video from Lesnar, where he mockingly congratulates Femi for beating him at WrestleMania 42. He says things won't end that way and questions if Femi can take a beating, then says a retired "Beast" will humble Femi and he will rule over him.

Back in the ring, Heyman says the good news is that everyone watching will have a chance to see history play out in real time. He says the bad news is that Femi has awakened "The Beast" .

Femi's music hits and he makes his way out. He stares down Heyman in the corner as the fans chant for him, then questions what Lesnar has awoken in him if Heyman says that if he's awoken "The Beast". He says as Heyman tells Lesnar what happened tonight, he'll fast forward to retiring Lesnar for a second time. He says he knows Heyman will say it's just business and not personal, but four F5s is personal to him and pulls out the contract for his Clash in Italy match against Lesnar.

Femi signs the contract and tells Heyman to let Lesnar know that last time he was fighting to beat him but this time he's fighting to kill.

Penta then makes his way to the ring. Je'Von Evans follows.

Penta (c) vs. Je'Von Evans for the Intercontinental Championship

The bell rings and the two men bump hands with one another as a show of respect. Evans sets up for the OG Cutter on Penta, but Penta sees him coming and looks to land a hurricanrana on Evans. Evans lands on his feet, and the two men come to a standstill before both hitting Penta's signature walk.

Evans flies out of the ring over the top rope to level Penta and dumps him back inside, then looks to fly off the top rope. Penta catches Evans with a superkick and lands a modified Bronco Buster on him, then goes for a pin but Evans kicks out. Evans sends Penta crashing back out of the ring with a flipping kick and looks to land a suicide dive on Penta, but Penta sees him coming and sends Evans crashing into the announce desk spine first.
